svg.text: Campus EVPN-VXLAN Network Architecture — Anycast Multihoming
Optimized for Campus Dual-Fiber Aggregation Cabling • OSPFv2 Underlay (Area 0) • iBGP EVPN (AS 65000) • Zero Spanning Tree
Core Layer — EVPN Route Reflectors & Tenant IP-VRF-1 Gateway
Building ISL (Dual 25G OSPF + Local iBGP /32 Host Peering)
State Reduction Design: /24 Type-5 advertised to Cores • /32 Host Routes isolated across ISL • Shared Anycast VTEP per Building Pair
